title: JM NDE 104
content:
I was at the beach with my family, and we were jumping the waves. I got caught in the undertow and at first tried to break through the surface. As my lungs began to feel like they would burst, I remember breathing in water and feeling so much better. At this point, I saw gill slits in the sides of my throat while my mind was thinking: 1. I was a mermaid, one of my favorite dreams; 2. I was a fish; 3. I told myself not to be silly, I was drowning. I was completely relaxed and felt total love. I could see shadows of people on both sides of me who knew me, but I didn't know them…but they were family. I heard the most beautiful music and was moving through a tunnel towards a light that I knew to be God. I was warm and glad to be going…then all of a sudden, the light exploded, and I awoke on the beach with people around me who had found me washed up. Everything was so loud and bright, and it hurt really badly, but I was ok. The funny part about this is I wanted to go back in the ocean because I knew God wouldn't let me drown, but my parents wouldn't let me (of course). To this day, I have no fear of water; I love to swim and go to the beach.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Completely relaxed; felt total love; breathing in water felt 'so much better'; perceived gill slits.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Moving through a tunnel toward a light.

arrival.other_being_detail: Saw 'shadows of people on both sides' who 'knew me' and were 'family' (experiencer did not know them).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Perceived gill slits/mermaid-or-fish thoughts while drowning; heard beautiful music; light 'exploded' before awakening.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No explicit OBE described; tunnel and light occurred after relaxation and seeing shadowy 'family'; abrupt return when light 'exploded.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived 'gill slits in the sides of my throat' and thoughts of being a mermaid/fish while drowning; heard 'the most beautiful music'; the light 'exploded' immediately before awakening.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was completely relaxed and felt total love.” / “I heard the most beautiful music and was moving through a tunnel towards a light that I knew to be God.” / “Everything was so loud and bright, and it hurt really badly, but I was ok.”
